title: YouTube to Blog settings
description: Frontmatter properties of 00 Home/Settings.md. Defaults mirror yt2b_common.DEFAULT_SETTINGS; an empty string falls back to the default.

author.description: Byline for every post and the Person node in the structured data.

site_url.description: Site root used for canonical URLs and the author link.

language.description: Caption language and the lang field of every post.

default_rights.description: Rights applied when a request does not set them; ask means the agent asks once per video.

default_mode.description: Article mode applied when a request does not set it.

max_blogs_per_video.description: Maximum angles the strategist may propose per video.

frame_width.description: Pixel width of frames extracted for articles.

max_frames_own.description: Frame cap per article for own videos.

max_frames_third_party.description: Frame cap per article for third-party videos.

keep_video.description: Keep the downloaded video in .cache/video after the run.

pause_for_outline.description: Open an outline approval before drafting each article.

max_video_minutes.description: Longer videos are refused unless --force-long is passed.

visuals.description: Visual ladder: real frames, plus SVG charts when the brief has data points, plus AI images through Banana Claude.
